sections.description: The Service Business theme is designed to provide a responsive and organized layout for presenting services, company details, announcements, and contact information. It includes customizable homepage sections, service display blocks, banner areas, navigation menus, and content sections that help organize information effectively across multiple devices. Customization settings allow users to modify colors, typography, headers, footers, and page layouts through an intuitive interface. The theme also includes blog functionality, testimonial sections, social media integration, widget-ready areas, and contact form compatibility to support content management and communication needs. Responsive design ensures content adapts smoothly to desktops, tablets, and smartphones while maintaining consistency in appearance. The theme is built with a clean code structure that supports performance, maintainability, and compatibility with widely used plugins. Additional features such as featured content areas, call-to-action sections, customizable banners, and flexible page templates help improve content organization. Structured navigation settings make it easier to access information throughout the website. By combining customization options, responsive functionality, and organized content sections, the theme provides a practical solution for creating and managing a professional online presence while following modern web standards.
